title: Check Your Books Every Month
summary: Catch bookkeeping errors against bank and card records, log receipts as they arrive and hand a tidy month to your accountant.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you keep your own books and pay an accountant at month end or year end.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Errors are found each month, not at tax time.
Your accountant gets a cleaner month-end pack.
who_its_for: Owner-run businesses on QuickBooks Online with an outside accountant.
